title: Domain profile
description: A crosswalk from one industry's own vocabulary into the coordinate system, plus the terms that crosswalk could not carry. The unmapped list is the point of the exercise: a profile with an empty `unmapped` array has almost certainly not been tested against the field, because no general vocabulary survives a real domain intact.

reviewed_by_practitioner.description: Whether someone who works in this field has checked the crosswalk. False is an honest and common answer; a profile nobody in the domain has read is a guess about the domain.

regulators.description: Named only as context for why the domain's vocabulary is shaped as it is. Naming a regulator is not a claim of its involvement, endorsement, or awareness.

terms.description: Domain terms that DO map. Each states what it maps to and what the mapping loses.

loses.description: What the domain term carries that the coordinate value does not. "nothing" is permitted but rare and should be suspected.

unmapped.description: Domain terms with no honest home in the vocabulary. This array is the finding. It is required, and it may be empty only with an explicit justification recorded in `unmapped_empty_because`.

current_workaround.description: What a project in this domain has to do today instead — usually collapsing the term into a coarser value and losing the distinction.

candidate_revision.description: A proposal id, once one exists. Absent means the finding is recorded but nobody has proposed a fix.

then.description: An empty finding list has to be defended in writing. Silence would let an untested profile look like a passed test.
